claim: Positive control for the sibling v0.1.6 receipt: with the identical local llama.cpp+vLLM backends, pointed at MIRIX main instead of v0.1.6, topic extraction succeeds and the meta-agent issues a real, well-formed trigger_memory_update tool call, and its semantic_memory_agent sub-agent produces a correct structured memory object purely from the local model's own output -- proving the local model and this host's setup are sound. The actual database write (semantic_memory_insert) then fails with the SAME underlying defect as finding F2 (embedding_model() never forwards embedding_model, always targets a hardcoded text-embedding-ada-002), reproduced deterministically twice (initial attempt and its own step_count:1 retry). Net result: partial -- local-model LLM orchestration works once the v0.1.6 schema bug is fixed; persistence does not.
limitations: main is not a release tag and is not proposed for adoption on that basis; cited only as evidence that the v0.1.6 defect is version-specific and already understood/fixed upstream, not as evidence MIRIX is ready to adopt.

Reaching even this partial result required three further undocumented workarounds beyond config changes: async/await added to the client calls and to the demo-key helper script, and a plain-string message-content shape instead of the list-of-parts shape shown in upstream's own README (findings F3/F4/F5 in results-20260926.json).
Whether episodic_memory_insert (a sibling sub-agent write that may not need an embedding) succeeds was not conclusively observed before this trial's time budget closed.
